title: Collectables - Brain in a Jar Guide
subtitle: How to start {quest} in Skyline Valley, what Dr. Regina Marcs wants with all those brains, how the hand-ins work, and what you get for them.

pills.label: Brain in a Jar Reward Checklist

sections.title: Finding Them
sections.html:
{finding_sentence}

  • Listen for them. Every jar makes a beeping noise that gets louder the closer you get.
    You can turn it up in Settings › Audio › Effects.
  • Look for them at night. The jars glow green after dark, so they stand out.
  • One per character. Once you pick one up, it won't respawn for that character.
  • They're yours only. Brains in Jars can't be dropped, traded or sold.
  • Track the challenge. Go to Menu › Challenges › Skyline Valley › Find your first Brain in a Jar and press Track.
  • Where they go. Brains go in the Misc tab of your Pip-Boy and stay there until you hand them in to Marcs.
  • XP. Each brain you pick up is worth a base of {pickup_xp} XP.

sections.title: How to Start {quest}
sections.html:
Option 1 – Pick up any Brain in a Jar

{quest} starts straight away, with the objective Find the source of the signal.

{img:start-pickup-brain}

sections.title: {quest} Walkthrough
sections.html:
Step 1 – Follow the signal to Rapidan Camp

When you pick up a brain, your Pip-Boy registers a set of coordinates, some sort of recall signal. They lead to Rapidan Camp in Skyline Valley, to the Brown House. Fast travel to Rapidan Camp: it has two fast travel points, so pick The Brown House and you arrive right at the door. Go inside.

{img:start-quest-log,start-signal-map,start-ft-rapidan,start-ft-brown-house,start-brown-house}

Step 2 – Speak to the Ghoul

Inside is a Ghoul who isn't pleased to see you and warns you she's armed. Talk to her and she soon notices the brain jar you're carrying. She is Dr. Regina Marcs, and she's collecting the brains.

{img:start-inside-brown-house,start-meet-marcs}

Step 3 – Make the deal

Hand over your brain and Marcs gives you a new weapon, the V63-Z Custom, a two-handed blade she calls "very fancy chopping power". She promises upgrades for it and recordings decoded from the brains if you keep bringing more.

{img:start-v63z-custom}

Step 4 – Collect brains and hand them in

The objective is now Collect brains in jars, then Return brain jars to Marcs. Bring them back to the Brown House in batches: see Handing In Brains to Dr. Marcs below.

Step 5 – The last batch

When you hand in the final batch, Marcs asks you to help her open a bunker hidden below the Brown House. What happens next is in The Finale below (spoilers).

sections.title: Handing In Brains to Dr. Marcs
sections.html:
Take your brains to Marcs at the Brown House in Rapidan Camp. She takes them in {batch_count} batches, and the quest objective shows how many you still need for the next one. Every hand-in pays some caps and gives you a holotape she has decoded from the brains:

{batch_table}

That is {quest_brains} brains for the whole quest, so you don't need all {total} for the quest itself.

You don't have to hand them in one batch at a time. Save them up and hand in as many as you like in one go: the game still counts the total and gives you a holotape for every batch your brains cover. Handing in more than one batch's worth won't break or skip anything.

{img:handin-give-brains,handin-scan-holotape}

sections.title: Quest Rewards
sections.html:
• Finishing {quest} pays {caps} caps, XP and a Skyline Valley loot roll.
  • Each brain you pick up is worth a base of {pickup_xp} XP.
  • Your first hand-in gives you the V63-Z Custom; every hand-in after that pays caps and a Scan holotape.
  • Finishing also unlocks the {camp_name} for your CAMP. It costs {camp_cost}, and you can place up to 10 of them. Build it from the CAMP Build menu: Decorations → Novelties.
{img:camp-brain-jar}

Every reward, with tick boxes: Brain in a Jar Reward Checklist.

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
Do I have to do the quest to get the lifetime rewards?

No. The lifetime challenges count every brain you find, all the way to {total}. The quest only needs {quest_brains} brains handed in to Marcs.

Can I hand in more brains than the batch needs?

Yes. Hand in as many as you have at once. The game counts them all and gives you a holotape for every batch they cover, so nothing breaks and you don't miss any tapes.

Can I give spare brains to a friend?

No, your friend is beyond help, sorry. Plus, Brains in Jars can't be dropped, traded or sold.

sections.title: The Finale
sections.html:
When you hand in the final batch, Marcs asks you to help her open a bunker hidden below the Brown House. She says the man inside may have gone feral, so expect a fight. You can say no and walk away with your rewards, but she makes it clear there's a bonus if you escort her down.

Step 1 – Get the last tape

Agree to help and Marcs gives you the last holotape she decoded. It's a set of song lyrics, and it's the key to the bunker.

Step 2 – Follow Marcs downstairs

Tell her you're ready and follow her down to the bunker door. Marcs says the password is 565 characters long, the length of the song's lyrics without spaces or punctuation. She types it in for you and the door opens.

The password, if you want to see it:

{password_block}{img:finale-bunker-door}

Step 3 – Find Iggy

The man inside is Iggy Stolz, and he's already dead. Ask Marcs about it and the truth comes out: she shot him herself after he stole her weather machine plans, and he crawled down here before he died.

{img:finale-iggy}

Dialogue check [PER 12+] – "This isn't adding up. You're hiding something." Needs Perception 12 or more. Marcs admits she and Iggy were planning to steal the weather machine plans together.

Step 4 – Deal with Marcs

Marcs wants to tie up loose ends, and you're one of them. The quest then turns into Kill Marcs or Flee the Brown House. Some answers in the conversation let you talk your way out of it; most end in a fight.

  • Dialogue check [Enclave] – "Wait... you mean the Enclave? I'm a member, too." Only if you have finished One of Us. Marcs lets you say a few more words before the fight.
  • Dialogue check [Ghoul] – "To do whatever it takes to survive as one of us..." Only if you are a Ghoul, when she asks what your role is. She calls a truce.

Either way, the quest is done and pays out (see Quest Rewards).

sections.title: Lore
sections.html:
Marcs was once Lieutenant Regina Marcs of Vault 63, where she led the weather manipulation research for a time, trading the job back and forth with Audrey Stolz. She came to Vault 63 from Atlas Observatory, along with Oberlin.

The brains come from a "Brain Bleaching" operation the Stolz family ran on the west coast, at Chez Alpine: Spa and Resort. Rich and famous guests, mostly from the film industry, were treated there by the "world-renowned Dr. Scheinmenn", and the recordings show Iggy Stolz interviewing them. Iggy was Hugo Stolz's adopted son, raised as the heir until Audrey was born.

Iggy was hunting for a secret in the brains: a musical called Sonny, O' My Boy that he believed Hugo had written for him. Marcs, meanwhile, wanted her own improved version of the weather machine plans, which Iggy stole. She decoded the brains to find the password Iggy set on the bunker, and in the end she tells you she is "an agent of America. The real one."

Every Scan holotape, with its full transcript, is on the Brain in a Jar Reward Checklist.
